REPLACE:nd_ate_cocoa_plantation = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = peasants
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = plantation_employment
	category = rgo_building_category
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = no
	expensive = no
	build_time = plantation_build_time

	country_potential = {
		has_advance = nd_ate_cocoa_economy
	}

	modifier = {
		local_production_efficiency = small_production_efficiency_bonus
		local_monthly_food_modifier = 0.0425
		local_laborers_desired_pop = 0.1
	}

	# Kola grows wild and tended in the forest belt; the game has no kola
	# good, and medicaments (the good of Yeji and Hulagan in the formable's
	# own land) stands for it, as it does for Oyo's kola grove. The gate is
	# the land the tree grows on (tropical jungle or forest, 29 of the 33
	# locations of the Akan and Gold Coast areas) in a market where the
	# good is grown or sold. Until 2026-10-02 the building made cocoa, a
	# crop that reached the Gold Coast in 1879, after the game's years.
	location_potential = {
		climate = tropical
		OR = {
			vegetation = jungle
			vegetation = forest
		}
		market ?= {
			OR = {
				is_produced_in_market = goods:medicaments
				is_traded_in_market = goods:medicaments
			}
		}
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		# Outputs from eu5-profit at the rural margin (20 percent).
		# Picking: timber for the drying racks and tools for the harvest.
		nd_ate_cocoa_cultivation = {
			lumber = 0.3
			tools = 0.1
			produced = medicaments
			output = 0.9
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}

		# Packing for the road north: baskets and wrapping leaves (fiber
		# crops) and pots that keep the nuts moist as far as Salaga.
		nd_ate_cocoa_processing = {
			fiber_crops = 0.3
			pottery = 0.2
			tools = 0.1
			produced = medicaments
			output = 1.32
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}
	}
	construction_demand = plantation_construction
}

REPLACE:nd_azt_chinampa_terrace = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = peasants
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = generic_peasant_building_employment
	category = rgo_building_category
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	build_time = rural_build_time

	country_potential = {
		has_advance = nd_azt_chinampa_system
	}

	modifier = {
		local_monthly_food_modifier = 0.085
		local_population_capacity = 0.5
		local_maize_output_modifier = 0.15
	}

	# Extraction is bound to the resource: you cannot mine, tap or
	# harvest maize where there is none. Without this the building
	# is a free resource generator in every location the owner holds.
	location_potential = {
		is_produced_in_location_market = goods:maize
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		nd_azt_chinampa_farming = {
			tools = 0.1
			produced = maize
			output = 0.36
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}
	}
	construction_demand = farm_constructions

REPLACE:nd_bno_pepper_estate = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = peasants
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = generic_peasant_building_employment
	category = rgo_building_category
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = no
	expensive = no
	build_time = rural_build_time

	country_potential = {
		has_advance = nd_bno_banjarmasin_pepper_trade
	}

	modifier = {
		local_monthly_food_modifier = 0.0425
		local_production_efficiency = small_production_efficiency_bonus
		local_pop_promotion_speed = 0.002
	}

	# Requires a real supply of pepper: the formable's own
	# territory has no source of it, so this is bound to the
	# location's market rather than to the soil. Without a gate
	# the building conjures the good anywhere the owner holds.
	location_potential = {
		market ?= {
			is_produced_in_market = goods:pepper
		}
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		# Sized to the rural margin. It stood at output 0.15 on a little
		# timber with no profit cap, five times its cost.
		nd_bno_pepper_cultivation = {
			lumber = 0.2
			tools = 0.1
			produced = pepper
			output = 0.144
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}
	}
	construction_demand = farm_constructions
}

REPLACE:nd_cel_clachan = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = peasants
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = generic_peasant_building_employment
	category = basic_industry_category
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = no
	city = no
	expensive = no
	build_time = rural_build_time

	country_potential = {
		has_advance = nd_cel_rundale_system
	}

	modifier = {
		local_monthly_food_modifier = 0.0425
		local_population_growth = 0.0005
	}

	# Extraction is bound to the resource: you cannot mine, tap or
	# harvest wool where there is none. Without this the building
	# is a free resource generator in every location the owner holds.
	location_potential = {
		is_produced_in_location_market = goods:wool
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		# Open from the day the clachan is built. The wool method below was
		# the building's only one and is locked until nd_cel_wool_trade
		# (an age later), which left the clachan with no method to run.
		nd_cel_rundale_upkeep = {
			tools = 0.05
			lumber = 0.05
			livestock = 0.05
			category = building_maintenance
		}
		# Unlocked by nd_cel_wool_trade.
		nd_cel_communal_farming = {
			livestock = 0.2
			produced = wool
			output = 0.144
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}
	}
	construction_demand = farm_constructions
}

REPLACE:nd_gre_olive_press = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = peasants
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = generic_peasant_building_employment
	category = consumer_goods_category
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = no
	expensive = no
	build_time = rural_build_time

	country_potential = {
		has_advance = nd_gre_olive_cultivation
	}

	modifier = {
		local_monthly_food_modifier = 0.0425
	}

	# Extraction is bound to the resource: you cannot mine, tap or
	# harvest wine where there is none. Without this the building
	# is a free resource generator in every location the owner holds.
	location_potential = {
		is_produced_in_location_market = goods:olives
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		nd_gre_olive_pressing = {
			livestock = 0.1
			lumber = 0.1
			produced = olives
			output = 0.36
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}
		nd_gre_currant_export = {
			fruit = 0.4
			produced = liquor
			output = 0.192
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}
	}
	# Profit check (nd_gre_olive_pressing):
	# olives 0.3x1.0 + livestock 0.1x1.5 = 0.45 input cost
	# 0.45 x 1.20 / 2.0 = 0.27 wine -> profit = 20% (15-30% range)
	#
	# Profit check (nd_gre_currant_export):
	# fruit 0.4x1.0 = 0.40 input cost
	# 0.40 x 1.20 / 2.5 = 0.192 -> round to 0.19 liquor -> profit = 18.75% (15-30% range)
	construction_demand = village_construction
}

	}

		local_unrest = -0.05
		local_peasants_estate_power = 0.5
		local_population_capacity = 0.5
		local_monthly_food_modifier = 0.0425
	}

		nd_iro_longhouse_maintenance = {
			lumber = 0.2225
			tools = 0.1114
			fiber_crops = 0.1114
			category = building_maintenance
		}

		# Unlocked by nd_iro_fur_trade_network: deer hides dressed and smoked
		# in the longhouse (the key keeps the older name). Vanilla's
		# forest_tannery makes leather from wild_game the same way. It stood in
		# the Three Sisters Garden as leather from fur until 2026-10-02.
		# Inputs cost 0.4 + 0.075 = 0.475; 0.19 leather at 3 is 0.57. The
		# longhouse can stand in the countryside, so the rural cap.
		nd_iro_fur_processing = {
			wild_game = 0.4
			lumber = 0.05
			produced = leather
			output = 0.19
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}
	}
	construction_demand = village_construction
}

		# Vanilla's rural clothmaker turns wool 0.5 into cloth 0.5
		# (rural_wool_clothmaker); felt is rolled, not woven, and needs
		# only mats and beaters beside the wool.
		nd_kaz_felt_production = {
			wool = 0.2
			tools = 0.05
			produced = cloth
			output = 0.26
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}
	}
	construction_demand = village_construction
}

REPLACE:nd_koj_sugar_press = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = peasants
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = plantation_employment
	category = basic_industry_category
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = no
	expensive = no
	build_time = plantation_build_time

	country_potential = {
		has_advance = nd_koj_sugar_estates
	}

	modifier = {
		local_production_efficiency = small_production_efficiency_bonus
		local_monthly_food_modifier = 0.0425
	}

	# Two gates, both load-bearing. Market supply: the press needs
	# cane, and Acre's own hinterland qualifies (acre's raw_material
	# is sugar in location_templates.txt), so the gate binds without
	# conjuring the good anywhere the owner holds. River: the
	# description promises a water-powered mill and the real Crusader
	# presses (Tawahin as-Sukkar by Jericho, the Acre and Tyre works)
	# ran on channeled water; without this the press was buildable on
	# any dry hilltop (workshop report, 2026-08-09).
	location_potential = {
		has_river = yes
		market ?= {
			is_produced_in_market = goods:sugar
		}
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		nd_koj_mill_upkeep = {
			lumber = 0.1
			tools = 0.05
			stone = 0.05
			category = building_maintenance
		}
		nd_koj_sugar_processing = {
			lumber = 0.1
			tools = 0.05
			produced = sugar
			output = 0.12
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}
	}
	construction_demand = plantation_construction
}

REPLACE:nd_kry_shilat_khaneh = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = laborers
	max_levels = 2
	employment_size = generic_peasant_building_employment
	category = basic_industry_category
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = no
	expensive = no
	build_time = rural_build_time

		has_advance = nd_kry_caspian_fisheries
	}

		local_fish_output_modifier = 0.15
		local_monthly_food_modifier = 0.0425
		local_laborers_desired_pop = 0.1
	}

	# Requires a real supply of fish: the formable's own
	# territory has no source of it, so this is bound to the
	# location's market rather than to the soil. Without a gate
	# the building conjures the good anywhere the owner holds.
	location_potential = {
		market ?= {
			is_produced_in_market = goods:fish
		}
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		# The default method. The sturgeon method below was the fishery's
		# only one and is unlocked two ages after the building, which left
		# the building with nothing to run in between.
		nd_kry_lagoon_fishing = {
			salt = 0.05
			produced = fish
			output = 0.24
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}
		# Unlocked by nd_kry_rice_fish_economy (age 5). Vanilla's fishing
		# village turns salt 0.0929 and tools 0.015 into fish 0.5.
		nd_kry_sturgeon_fishing = {
			salt = 0.1
			tools = 0.02
			produced = fish
			output = 0.552
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}
	}
	construction_demand = village_construction

REPLACE:nd_lbe_upemba_fishery = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = peasants
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = generic_peasant_building_employment
	category = rgo_building_category
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = no
	expensive = no
	build_time = rural_build_time

	country_potential = {
		has_advance = nd_lbe_lake_fishing_tradition
	}

	modifier = {
		local_monthly_food_modifier = 0.085
		local_fish_output_modifier = 0.15
		local_laborers_desired_pop = 0.1
	}

	# Extraction is bound to the resource: you cannot mine, tap or
	# harvest fish where there is none. Without this the building
	# is a free resource generator in every location the owner holds.
	location_potential = {
		is_produced_in_location_market = goods:fish
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		nd_lbe_fishery_maintenance = {
			lumber = 0.1
			tools = 0.05
			fiber_crops = 0.05
			category = building_maintenance
		}

		nd_lbe_lake_fishery_pm = {
			lumber = 0.1

REPLACE:nd_out_rais_house = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = peasants
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = bailiff_employment
	category = government_category
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = no
	expensive = no
	build_time = rural_build_time

	country_potential = {
		has_advance = nd_out_rais_and_dragoman
	}

	# Only where the village is not of the crown's own faith. Where it is,
	# there is nothing for a ra'is to mediate and the office historically
	# did not exist: the Frankish new towns were run by a dispensator
	# instead. OUT_f gates on religion = catholic, so naming the religion
	# here is exact rather than a guess about the builder.
	location_potential = {
		NOT = { dominant_religion = religion:catholic }
	}

	# The bailiff bargain, deliberately: control over a village you do not
	# staff, bought by handing the peasantry real standing and taking the
	# crown's own agents out of the loop.
	modifier = {
		local_max_control = 0.05
		local_peasants_estate_power = 1.0
		local_crown_estate_power = -0.25
		local_unrest = -0.05
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		nd_out_rais_maintenance = {
			paper = 0.1339
			wheat = 0.1339
			olives = 0.1339
			category = building_maintenance
		}
	}
	construction_demand = village_construction
}

REPLACE:nd_out_sanctuary_wardenship = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = religious_building_employment
	category = religious_category
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	expensive = no
	build_time = religious_building_time

	country_potential = {
		has_advance = nd_out_wardens_of_the_sanctuaries
	}

	# The reach is vanilla's own holy site list, which is the tightest and
	# most honest gate available: a warden can only be posted where there is
	# a sanctuary to guard, and only where that sanctuary belongs to someone
	# else. Catholic sites are not listed because the crown's own church
	# needs no protection from the crown.
	location_potential = {
		OR = {
			is_location_holy_site_for = religion:sunni
			is_location_holy_site_for = religion:shia
			is_location_holy_site_for = religion:ibadi
			is_location_holy_site_for = religion:orthodox
			is_location_holy_site_for = religion:miaphysite
			is_location_holy_site_for = religion:nestorianism
			is_location_holy_site_for = religion:judaism
			is_location_holy_site_for = religion:druzism
			is_location_holy_site_for = religion:samaritanism
			is_location_holy_site_for = religion:mandeaism
		}
	}

	# The conversion block is the point, not an oversight. A warden who
	# permits a mission is not a warden. Building this is a permanent
	# decision to stop converting that location in exchange for its quiet.
	modifier = {
		local_unrest = -0.085
		local_clergy_estate_power = 0.5
		local_monthly_prosperity = 0.001
		local_clergy_conversion_blocked = yes
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		nd_out_wardenship_maintenance = {
			incense = 0.1
			olives = 0.1
			paper = 0.1
			category = building_maintenance
		}
	}
	construction_demand = important_building_construction
}

REPLACE:nd_the_krokos_house = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = peasants
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = generic_peasant_building_employment
	category = consumer_goods_category
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = no
	expensive = no
	build_time = rural_build_time

	country_potential = {
		has_advance = nd_the_krokos_of_kozani
	}

	# Bound to the crop. Saffron will not grow where the crocus does not,
	# and a drying house without fields around it produces nothing out of
	# nothing.
	location_potential = {
		is_produced_in_location_market = goods:saffron
	}

	modifier = {
		local_peasants_estate_power = 0.25
		local_monthly_food_modifier = 0.0425
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		# Input fix: tools (fuel and equipment only, no harvest) replaced
		# with wheat, the rotation grain grown on the same terraced plots
		# as the crocus, so the PM has an actual feedstock behind the kiln.
		# Profit check: lumber 0.3x1.5 + wheat 0.1x1.0 = 0.55 input cost
		# 0.55 x 1.20 / 5.0 = 0.1319 saffron -> ~20% margin
		nd_the_krokos_drying = {
			lumber = 0.3
			wheat = 0.1
			produced = saffron
			output = 0.132
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}
	}
	construction_demand = village_construction
}

REPLACE:nd_the_metochion = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = peasants
	max_levels = 2
	employment_size = generic_peasant_building_employment
	category = consumer_goods_category
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = no
	expensive = no
	build_time = rural_build_time

	country_potential = {
		has_advance = nd_the_metochia_of_the_holy_mountain
	}

	# A metochion is an Orthodox monastery's estate. A Catholic crown can
	# license one, endow one and tax one, but it cannot conjure one among
	# its own Latins: the house, the steward and the paroikoi are all
	# Orthodox. This gate is the country's central fact expressed as reach,
	# and it also keeps the estate out of the crown's own core.
	location_potential = {
		dominant_religion ?= religion:orthodox
	}

	modifier = {
		local_clergy_estate_power = 0.5
		local_clergy_desired_pop = 0.05
		local_monthly_food_modifier = 0.0425
		local_peasant_enfranchisment = -0.01
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		# Profit check: fruit 0.3x1.0 + wheat 0.1x1.0 = 0.40 input cost
		# 0.40 x 1.20 / 2.5 = 0.192 liquor -> 20% margin
		nd_the_tsipouro_still = {
			fruit = 0.3
			wheat = 0.1
			produced = liquor
			output = 0.192
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}
		# Profit check: fiber_crops 0.15x2.0 + lumber 0.1x1.5 = 0.45
		# 0.45 x 1.20 / 2.0 = 0.27 paper -> 20% margin
		nd_the_monastic_scriptorium = {
			fiber_crops = 0.15
			lumber = 0.1
			produced = paper
			output = 0.27
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}
	}
	construction_demand = village_construction
}

REPLACE:nd_tws_masseria = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = peasants
	max_levels = 3
	employment_size = generic_peasant_building_employment
	category = basic_industry_category
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = no
	expensive = no
	build_time = rural_build_time

	country_potential = {
		has_advance = nd_tws_masseria_system
	}

	modifier = {
		local_monthly_food_modifier = 0.085
		local_wheat_output_modifier = 0.15
		local_population_capacity = 0.5
	}

	# Extraction is bound to the resource: you cannot mine, tap or
	# harvest livestock where there is none. Without this the building
	# is a free resource generator in every location the owner holds.
	location_potential = {
		is_produced_in_location_market = goods:livestock
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		# From the start: the estate's own flock on its stubble. It was the
		# building's only method and stood locked behind an age 2 advance, so
		# an age 1 masseria had nothing to run.
		nd_tws_stubble_grazing = {
			tools = 0.05
			salt = 0.02
			produced = livestock
			output = 0.184
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}
		# Unlocked by nd_tws_mediterranean_granary: the grain surplus fattens
		# herds kept for breeding. Fodder and breeding stock in, more stock
		# out, the shape of vanilla's horse_breeders (wheat and horses make
		# horses). Inputs cost 0.4 + 0.15 + 0.15 = 0.7; 0.56 livestock at 1.5
		# is 0.84, the rural margin of 20%.
		nd_tws_grain_export = {
			wheat = 0.4
			livestock = 0.1
			tools = 0.05
			produced = livestock
			output = 0.56
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
		}
	}
	construction_demand = farm_constructions
}
